  "root_cause": "The inbound ACL on the server's VLAN interface permits ICMP and SSH (port 22) from the IT subnet (10.10.5.0/24), but lacks permit statements for HTTP (port 80) and HTTPS (port 443), causing web traffic to be blocked by the implicit deny-all rule.",

  "fix_steps": [
    "Enter global configuration mode on the router or switch where the ACL is applied.",

    "Verify HTTP/HTTPS access from the IT staff subnet to the server."
  ]
}
